---
name: Skill request
about: Ask for an Excel or PowerPoint skill that does not exist yet
labels: skill-request
---

## The repeated task

What do you do in Excel or PowerPoint again and again? Describe the finish line: what the deck looks like when the task is done.

## Built-ins you tried first

What happened when you asked Copilot in the app directly, or used Review this presentation, Visualize this slide, Prepare for Questions or Create interactive slide? Where did it fall short?

## Who runs it and how often

Role and frequency (for example: programme manager, monthly). Real demand evidence, such as a public forum thread, strengthens the case.

## What must stay with a person

Which part of the task is a decision a human must make? The skill will draft up to that point and stop.
